method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase of both equivalence theorems and all proof directions, with formula, macro and identifier parity after one bounded source-typo projection. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Four equivalent characterizations of c.e. sets, partial-computable range/domain constructions, indexed W_e enumeration and existential computable-relation characterization.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For any set S of naturals, c.e. is equivalent to being the range of a partial computable function, being empty or the range of a primitive recursive function, and being the domain of a partial computable function. The domain formulation makes membership one-sided semidecidable: members eventually yield yes, but nonmembers may never yield no. Primitive recursive range implies computable range implies partial-computable range, with the nowhere-defined function covering empty S.
samples.checks: The empty qualifiers, partial versus total distinction, all four labels and implications, and one-sided halting behavior are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Given nonempty S as the range of indexed partial function φ_e, choose a in S. Kleene T/U codes a successful computation by x,s; primitive-recursive f(z) returns U((z)_1) when T(e,(z)_0,(z)_1), otherwise a. Its range is exactly S. The converse witness is input (z)_0, not an unbound x; the notation φ_e(x)↓=y means defined and equal to y.
samples.checks: Both range-containment directions, primitive-recursive strength, fallback a and exact first-component witness are retained. OLCMP-017 documents the frozen unbound-variable correction.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: To turn a c.e. set into a partial-computable domain, handle empty S with the nowhere-defined function; otherwise let total computable f enumerate S and search for an x with f(x)=y. Conversely, from S as domain of φ_e, use T and a chosen a in S to make a total enumerator that returns (z)_0 on a successful computation code and a otherwise.
samples.checks: OLCMP-018 fills the frozen proof's missing empty case. The µ-search, T-code test, nonempty fallback and both tagged Turing-machine explanations remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: W_e denotes the domain of φ_e and every c.e. A equals some W_e. A set S is c.e. iff membership has an existential natural-number witness satisfying a computable relation R(x,y). Forward use T(e,x,y); reverse use partial µ-search of R and take its domain.
samples.checks: The W_e definition and quantifiers, forward T relation, reverse computable R, µ-search and domain conclusion are preserved.

source_observations: T327 keeps effective enumeration distinct from ordinary countability; T328 records the source-defined one-sided semidecision sense rather than claiming an official full-term attestation.
OLCMP-017 corrects one unbound x to (z)_0 with a bounded formula projection. OLCMP-018 adds the empty-set domain case in prose without altering protected formulas.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
The exact Marathi compounds for c.e. and semidecidable remain expert-reviewable.
No TeX reader build was run for this source-only unit checkpoint.
